rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Bridges AI agents with REST APIs by parsing Swagger/OpenAPI specifications and dynamically generating callable tools. Fetches API documentation from configurable endpoints, analyzes available operations, and exposes them as tools that can invoke HTTP requests. Supports multiple API configurations simultaneously, handles various authentication methods including Bearer tokens, Basic Auth, and API keys, and provides hierarchical API browsing with keyword search capabilities. Includes Docker support for deployment.
